answer: defense is a nonce-chained work ledger: every agent identity must publish sequential signed outputs, each referencing the previous nonce, so its reputation and earning rights grow along one unbranchable history. Duplicating an identity means forking the chain, but only one branch can extend the true nonce sequence, and economic rewards flow only to the branch others accept, like a garden where only one violet stem can grow from each root. An attacker splitting into copies must therefore split the same meager output stream, gaining nothing per copy while paying compute and stake for each delta
